Collaborate with your fellow game makers

A creative and curious mind

A strong passion for art, games and relevant technologies

Excellent visual skillset and deep artistic understanding and knowledge

jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a dynamic Business Development Manager/ Key Account Manager to lead our professional channel expansion in the Nordic region (primarily Sweden and neighboring countries). This role will focus on building and developing key partnerships across sectors such as security, networking (PoE), creative printing, garden tools, and audiovisual solutions — helping our products succeed in non-traditional, multi-tier distribution environments.
Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute business strategies for B2B and professional sales channels in the Nordic region.

Identify, engage, and manage key accounts including regional distributors, installers, and service providers.

Deeply understand local industry structures—installers, resellers, service providers, and DIY/professional dealers—and tailor expansion plans accordingly.

Build trust-based relationships with key customers and channel partners to integrate our products into their business models.

Evaluate channel potential and new business opportunities, and propose feasible growth initiatives for each product category.

Collaborate closely with HQ and product teams to refine GTM strategies (pricing, positioning, promotions, and channel mapping).

Prepare regular business reports, forecasts, and performance reviews to support strategic decision-making.

Play a pivotal role in developing a multi-category commercial presence and establishing our long-term local operations foundation.

Requirements

Fluent in Swedish and English, with a Bachelor’s degree or above in Marketing, Business, or related fields.

3–5 years of experience in B2B or professional channel sales in Northern Europe—preferably within security, networking, AV, or creative printing industries.

Strong understanding of Nordic consumer electronics and enterprise ecosystems; existing relationships with major distributors are a plus.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills across technical and business contexts.

Capable of market analysis and channel mapping, with solid business acumen and data-driven decision ability.

Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to work independently while collaborating with global HQ teams.

Passionate about emerging technology categories and creative business models.

Strong teamwork ethic, organizational capability, and ability to thrive in a fast-evolving, multi-category environment.

Location:

Preferably based in Sweden (Stockholm area), with flexibility to travel across Nordic countries.

Interested candidates, Kindly share your resume at neha@minnovation.se

Technical Office Manager
About the position

In this key position, you will be responsible for managing technical documentation, engineering coordination, quality control, and contract administration on-site. Avarda Group simplifies how customers across Europe manage their personal finances. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2016, we combine a pragmatic business mindset with cutting-edge technology to deliver scalable, efficient payment, savings, and lending solutions.
We are looking for a Senior Software Developer to join our distributed engineering team and play a key role in building the payment solutions of the future. You will work on our .NET microservices backend — primarily hosted in Azure, with Corniche as our API-driven core banking system at its heart — collaborating with engineers across Borås, Stockholm, Gdansk, Málaga, and the Czech Republic. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you will contribute to technical direction, share knowledge across the team, and help shape our platform and engineering culture.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and development of microservices and their architecture using .NET Core

Drive cloud-based solution design, ensuring robust, scalable, and reliable services on Azure Cloud Native

Oversee CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows using Kubernetes, Docker, and Azure Pipelines

Optimize systems and applications for high performance, reliability, and maintainability

Implement and improve logging and observability using OpenTelemetry

Share knowledge and support developers of varying seniority, contributing to technical and architectural discussions

Collaborate across distributed teams and ensure alignment on technical strategy and best practices

What We're Looking For
5+ years of software engineering experience with strong expertise in C#, .NET Core, and Azure

Proven experience with transaction-intensive systems and agile development processes

Deep understanding of microservices architecture and distributed system design

A collaborative, team-first mindset with a passion for engineering quality

Fluent in English and Swedish

Experience in e-commerce, payments, or finance is a plus, as well as familiarity with systems like Corniche or Mambu

What We Offer
A hands-on technical role with real impact on platform architecture and direction

The opportunity to work on a modern, unified payment platform serving 14 European markets

A collaborative, distributed team with a strong engineering culture

Growth opportunities both technically and professionally

Sounds Exciting? We are recruiting with clear goals for the future. If you feel stuck in your current role, always dreamt about real estate or are ready for a new challenge, we’d love to hear from you! Submit your application as soon as possible, and we’ll get back to you with more details. Rest assured, your application will be handled with complete confidentiality. 
About Svensk Fastighetsförmedling Svensk Fastighetsförmedling is Sweden's largest nationwide and independent real estate agency. Join our dedicated team of 1250 colleagues who support each other and grow together. We continuously strive to create a thriving work environment and have been recognized as one of Sweden's most attractive employers for several years running. As an employee, you'll have access to ongoing training, unique tools, and opportunities for partnership. Our focus is on leading today and in the future.
Warmly welcome your application!
Learn more about us here:
https://jobb.svenskfast.se/
https://www.facebook.com/svenskfastkarriar/
https://www.instagram.com/livetpasvenskfast/

The Impact You'll Make
 
As our new Application Engineer in Sweden, you'll be a key technical partner to our customers and sales team, turning customer needs into practical drive and power conversion solutions. 
 

You'll join a small, experienced Swedish team working across the country. This gives you a broad role with exposure to different customers, industries and applications. Rather than focusing on one specific segment, you'll use your technical expertise where it creates the most value, particularly for key customers and during the pre-sales phase. 

 

You'll support customers from the first technical discussion through solution design, sizing and quotation to implementation. You'll have the independence to manage customer relationships in Sweden while working closely with technical and commercial colleagues across Sweden, Denmark and Norway. 

 

The role offers flexibility in where you work. You can be based in the Stockholm, Linköping, Göteborg or Malmö area, including locations within reasonable travelling distance, and combine homeworking with customer visits and time at a Danfoss office. 
What You’ll Be Doing
 
Work with customers and our sales team to understand technical requirements and assisting system designs, supporting customer meetings, project scoping and pre-sales discussions. 
Dimension and select frequency converters, drives and power conversion solutions for different applications.
Act as a trusted technical partner to key customers, taking technical ownership of their applications from initial requirements and product selection through technical clarification, verification, implementation and commissioning on site.
Perform technical analyses, testing and evaluations against customer specifications, helping customers and sales colleagues solve technical challenges.
Share your expertise through technical presentations, product and software training, and collaboration with sales, service partners and technical colleagues across Scandinavia. 

 
You'll have regular contact with customers, so travel is a natural part of the role. You can expect 20-30 travel days per year, mainly within Sweden, with occasional travel to Denmark and Norway. 
 
What We're Looking For
We're open to different educational and career paths. What matters most is a strong technical foundation, practical electrical understanding and an interest in working directly with customers. 
 
To succeed in this role, you'll bring: 
A technical background in electrical engineering, automation, mechatronics or a related field. You may also have started your career as an electrician or electrical installer and are now ready for the next step.
Practical electrical knowledge and an interest in motor control, frequency converters, drives and power conversion.
The ability to work independently, translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions and manage different priorities.
Confidence working directly with customers and supporting sales colleagues in technical and pre-sales discussions.
Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken. Swedish is essential for customer collaboration in Sweden, while English is used across our Scandinavian organization. 

 
Experience with drives, frequency converters, power conversion, electrification or similar technologies is an advantage, but not essential. Familiarity with Danfoss Drives products or Salesforce would also be beneficial. 
 
Most importantly, you bring technical curiosity, initiative and a willingness to learn. We value practical experience alongside formal education, so if you've built your expertise through hands-on work combined with further technical learning, we'd encourage you to apply. 
What You'll Get from Us
 
You'll join a small, experienced Swedish team where you'll have significant independence and the opportunity to build close relationships with customers and sales colleagues. At the same time, you'll be part of a wider Scandinavian technical community where knowledge, expertise and assignments are shared across Sweden, Denmark and Norway. 
 
The breadth of the Swedish market means you'll work with different customers and applications rather than being limited to one segment. It's an opportunity to deepen your technical expertise, develop your commercial understanding and take real ownership of customer challenges. 
 
The position offers a flexible hybrid working model, including the possibility of working from home. Depending on where you're based and the needs of the role, your week may combine homeworking, customer visits and time at a Danfoss office. 
 
We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths. 
 
You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. 
 
You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed. 
 
You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.
Ready to Make a Difference?
 
If you enjoy combining hands-on technical expertise with customer interaction and want the freedom to take ownership of technical challenges, we'd like to hear from you. 
 

You don't need to come from one specific educational or industry background. If you have strong electrical knowledge, enjoy solving technical problems and are motivated to develop your expertise in drives and power conversion, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every preferred qualification. 

 

Apply and help us turn customer challenges into practical drive and power conversion solutions.

SalMar is one of the world's leading salmon producers - and the most sustainable food producer on the planet  (Global 100, Davos 2026!). With operations across Norway, sales offices in Asia, and a team of over 3,345 people, we turn innovation, passion, and pure Norwegian seawater into world-class salmon. Want to help shape the future of sustainable seafood? Dive in with us! Head office is located at InnovaMar on Frøya in Trøndelag. 
 

Why Join SalMar?
Become part of a diverse team representing over 40 nationalities. At SalMar, we're more than a company - we're a community built on innovation, collaboration, and excellence. Here, you'll work in a modern facility with access to an on-site gym and cafeteria serving good, nutritious meals, while being part of a global leader in sustainable aquaculture.

As a Production Team Member at InnovaMar, you'll be at the core of our operations, contributing to the harvesting and processing of premium salmon. Experience in salmon or food production is an advantage, but not required.

Strong team spirit and collaboration skills.

Shared platforms create the greatest value when they combine strong standards with a clear understanding of the business. As Head of Common Solutions, you own the common business application platforms that support several divisions across Business Area Rock Processing. By bringing business priorities together in one coherent roadmap, you enable commercial growth, operational efficiency, and compliance across the business area. 
About the job 
You own the strategy, delivery, operation, and continued development of our common business application platforms, primarily ERP and CRM. Working across autonomous divisions, you translate different business requirements into shared priorities while balancing standardization with genuine local needs. You report to the VP IT and CIO of Rock Processing and are a member of the IT management team. 
Job responsibilities 
Own and develop the multi-year ERP and CRM strategy, roadmap and investment plan across the business area. 
Establish a structured process for evaluating and prioritizing business requirements, with clear outcomes and ownership of expected benefits. 
Lead the Common Solutions organization and build a product-oriented operating model with clear accountability, competence development, and succession planning. 
Ensure successful delivery of platform programs and releases, including process design, data migration, training, change management and business readiness. 
Take accountability for platform performance, lifecycle management, service levels, total cost of ownership and transparent cost allocation. 
Strengthen data quality, compliance and risk management while providing a reliable foundation for analytics, automation, digital solutions, and AI. 

 Location and flexibility 
This position is flexible within Sweden, and regular international travel is expected. 
Your profile 
You’re an experienced IT leader with a strong understanding of industrial business processes and a proven ability to lead shared platforms across international, multi-business organizations. Your background combines strategic platform ownership, complex delivery and people leadership in environments where progress depends on collaboration and influence. 
Your background includes: 
Extensive experience leading ERP and CRM platforms, including a full end-to-end implementation or major upgrade. 
A strong track record of delivering common solutions across autonomous business units with their own profit and loss responsibility. 
Experience owning significant platform budgets, cost allocation models and vendor portfolios. 
Leadership experience with distributed, multicultural teams of leaders and specialists. 
A university degree in engineering, business, information systems or an equivalent field, together with professional fluency in English.  

Knowledge of Infor M3 CloudSuite, Salesforce, product-oriented IT operating models, integration and data architecture is advantageous. Experience from heavy industry, as well as platform harmonization following acquisitions, is also beneficial. 
To succeed, you listen closely to the divisions and build solutions around their strategies and business models. You combine sound judgment with the confidence to protect a common core, influence stakeholders without formal authority, and turn strategic priorities into funded, well-structured delivery. Curious about what’s next, you bring developments in digitalization, automation, and AI into the platform agenda while building long-term capability within your team. 
The team 
You lead an indicative team of five to ten platform or product owners and solution architects for ERP and CRM, supported by program and delivery resources. Close collaboration with divisional Digital and IT business partners, business process owners, Digital Transformation and AI, IT Sourcing, the BA IT PMO and Group IT is central to the work. 
Our culture 
At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

Chalmers University of Technology is seeking a Director for ourhttps://www.chalmers.se/en/research/infrastructure/ecommons/ (e-commons) who combines professional expertise and sound judgement with strong leadership and a clear focus on delivery. We are looking for a leader with a collaborative mindset, who puts the mission and collective success first, takes a broad organisational perspective, works effectively across organisational boundaries, and creates an environment that enables individuals and teams to succeed.
About us 
Chalmers University of Technology is driving academic excellence in order to address the challenges and needs of society and industry. We offer a creative and dynamic environment for research, education, innovation and applied science. 
Chalmers e-infrastructure Commons (e-commons) is our integrated digital infrastructure for research, providing advanced digital resources, services, and expertise to support research activities across all our 12 departments. The e-commons services cover the life cycle of research data by integrating functions embedded at different parts of the university with functions available in national and international e-infrastructure initiatives and collaborations. The mission of e-commons is defined by the central Research Committee of Chalmers with representatives from all departments.  
The host department for e-commons is https://www.chalmers.se/en/departments/physics-and-astronomy/ 
The Role 
As Director of e-commons, you will hold a strategically important leadership role at Chalmers, with overall responsibility for leading and developing e-commons and ensuring high-quality, reliable services for the research community. You will also serve as Head of Division for the computational infrastructure within the Department of Physics and Astronomy.  
You will set direction, build a strong and collaborative organisation, and bring together people and expertise across organisational boundaries to turn complex research needs into effective solutions. You will ensure that e-commons evolves in line with Chalmers’ needs and the developments in national and international e-infrastructures. 
Your key responsibilities include: 
Leading and developing e-commons in accordance with its mission, budget, operational plans, strategic objectives, and established policies, while ensuring the infrastructure continues to meet emerging research needs and developments in national and international e-infrastructures.  
Holding overall responsibility for personnel, work environment, and operational management of the division, which currently consists of approximately 20 employees.  
Advising the Vice President for Research and the Research Committee on e-infrastructure matters. 
Collaborating with other support functions and research infrastructures. The position may involve representing the university in national and international e-science contexts. 

Qualifications and merits
The successful candidate should have:
A master’s degree in a relevant field. 
Proven leadership and management experience. 
Experience in leading and collaborating within complex organisations. 
Extensive knowledge of the e-infrastructure domain, including its current developments, opportunities, and challenges. 
Excellent communication skills in English and Swedish, both written and spoken. 

The following qualifications are considered advantageous: 
A doctoral degree in a field relevant to the operational activities of e-commons. 
Broad understanding of e-infrastructure needs across different research disciplines. 
An established national and international professional network within the field. 
Leadership experience within an e-infrastructure organisation. 

Personal Characteristics 
You are an experienced, collaborative, and pragmatic leader with sound judgement, integrity, and a strong focus on quality. You listen to different perspectives, build trust, and bring people together around shared goals, while being prepared to make clear and well-considered decisions when needed. 
As a leader, you create the conditions for people and teams to succeed, take a broad organisational perspective, and work effectively across organisational boundaries.  
You are comfortable navigating complexity and balancing different needs and priorities, maintaining a clear focus on the mission defined by the needs of Chalmers’ researchers. 
Employment terms 
Full-time, permanent position as Director. 
The recruitment of the Director follows Chalmers’ guidelines for leadership appointments and is carried out by a recruitment committee. The final decision is made by the head of the Department of Physics and Astronomy. 
Start date by agreement. 
What we offer
At Chalmers, you will have the opportunity to lead a strategically important research infrastructure that supports world-class research and innovation. You will work in an international, collaborative, and dynamic environment alongside leading researchers, technical experts, and university leadership. 
This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of research infrastructure at Chalmers and contribute to national and international developments in e-infrastructure and e-science. 
 
Read more about what we offer at www.chalmers.se
 
Application
Applications must be in English and submitted through the Chalmers recruitment portal. All files should be in PDF format (max 40 MB each; ZIP files not supported). 
Include: 
CV  
Personal letter 
Other documents (optional): copies of completed education, leadership training.  

Only complete applications submitted through the portal will be considered. 
 
A background check may be conducted as part of the application process. 
 
Application deadline: January 10th, 2027
Contact
For questions about the position, please contact:
Margareta Wallquist, Advisor, University Executive Office, Chalmers Operations Support
 
Email: mailto:margareta.wallquist@chalmers.se
We look forward to your application!

Purpose of the Job
 To design, build and continuously improve Ikano Bank's native Android mobile applications, creating secure, simple and reliable banking experiences for customers across our markets. The role will help drive our Mobile First ambition by combining strong engineering craft, modern Android development practices, DevSecOps, automation and close collaboration with product, design and technology teams.
 
 Responsibilities of the Job
 • Design, develop, test and maintain native Android applications for Ikano Bank's mobile banking products.
 • Build secure, reliable and scalable mobile features using modern Android engineering practices.
 • Collaborate closely with product owners, designers, backend engineers, architects, security and operations teams.
 • Contribute to technical design, solution architecture and implementation decisions for mobile capabilities.
 • Ensure high quality through automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and strong release discipline.
 • Support Google Play releases, monitoring, incident analysis and continuous improvement of the mobile app.
 • Apply DevSecOps principles, including secure coding, privacy-by-design and early identification of risks.
 • Improve developer productivity through automation, modern tooling and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering.
 • Translate business and customer needs into clear technical tasks and deliverable solutions.
 • Mentor colleagues, share knowledge and help raise the engineering standards of the mobile team.
 • Challenge existing ways of working and contribute to Ikano Bank's broader technology transformation.
 
 Experience/Demonstrated Competencies
 • Several years of professional experience developing native Android applications, preferably for customer-facing digital products.
 • Demonstrated experience building, releasing and maintaining high-quality mobile apps in production.
 • Proven ability to work with Kotlin, modern Android frameworks and mobile architecture patterns.
 • Experience working in cross-functional product teams with designers, product owners, backend engineers, architects and security specialists.
 • Demonstrated ability to deliver secure, reliable and maintainable software in a regulated or high-quality engineering environment.
 • Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and Google Play release processes.
 • Proven ability to translate business and customer needs into clear technical solutions.
 • Experience improving engineering practices, development workflows and team productivity.
 • Demonstrated ability to communicate technical topics clearly and work constructively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 • Experience mentoring other developers or contributing to stronger engineering standards within a team.
 • Demonstrated curiosity and openness to modern tools, automation and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering.
 • Experience from banking, fintech, insurance or another high-security environment is considered an advantage.
 
 Language Competencies
 Tech Stacks: Kotlin (required). Python is a bonus, as the mobile team also contributes to the Python BFF (backend-for-frontend)
 Language: Professional in written and spoken English
 
 Knowledge required
 • Strong knowledge of native Android development using Kotlin.
 • Good understanding of Jetpack Compose, Android Jetpack libraries and modern Android application architecture.
 • Experience with Kotlin Coroutines, Flow and responsive mobile application design.
 • Knowledge of mobile architecture patterns such as MVVM, MVI, modular architecture or clean architecture, and dependency injection with Hilt/Dagger or Koin.
 • Experience integrating mobile apps with REST APIs, WebSockets and backend services.
 • Understanding of secure mobile development, authentication, secure storage, privacy-by-design and app hardening.
 • Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and mobile release processes.
 • Knowledge of Google Play Console submission, app signing, keystores, Gradle build configuration and release management.
 • Familiarity with tools such as GitHub, Jira, Figma, Jenkins, Gradle, Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions or similar.
 • Understanding of agile and DevSecOps ways of working.
 • Fluent English, both spoken and written.
 • Experience from banking, fintech or another regulated/high-security environment is an advantage.
 • Knowledge of AWS, Kafka, feature flags, observability or AI-assisted engineering tools is also valuable.
 
 Capabilities for this job
 • Ability to take ownership of mobile features from idea and design through development, release and continuous improvement.
 • Ability to write clean, maintainable and secure code in a banking environment.
 • Ability to understand customer and business needs and translate them into robust technical solutions.
 • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team with product, design, backend, architecture, security and operations.
 • Ability to challenge assumptions, ask good questions and improve solutions without creating unnecessary friction.
 • Ability to balance speed, quality, security and long-term maintainability.
 • Ability to analyse technical problems, make pragmatic decisions and communicate trade-offs clearly.
 • Ability to work with modern engineering practices, including automation, testing, CI/CD and DevSecOps.
 • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies, tools and ways of working.
 • Ability to mentor others, share knowledge and contribute to a stronger engineering culture.
 • Ability to use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve productivity while maintaining quality and control.
 
 What motivates you?
 You are motivated by building mobile products that customers rely on every day. You care about creating simple, secure and high-quality digital experiences, and you take pride in strong engineering craft, clean code and reliable delivery.
 
 You enjoy working in a team where ideas are challenged, decisions are made, and technology is used to solve real customer and business problems. You are curious about modern Android development, automation, AI-assisted engineering and better ways of working, and you want to help shape the future of mobile banking at Ikano Bank.

jobs.occupation: Produktionsmedarbetare med ansvar för Pack & Utleverans
jobs.description:
(English text below)
Om jobbet
Söker du ett praktiskt arbete där du får kombinera fysiskt packningsarbete med att schemalägga tillverkningen i fabrikens produktion? Hos Swedish Nutra i Mellersta Hamnen, Malmö, söker vi en noggrann medarbetare som vill ta ansvar för att våra produkter etiketteras, packas och färdigställs för leverans i tid.
I denna roll får du förtroende att analysera ordrar och lagersaldon för att schemalägga tillverkningsbatcher åt blandningsteamet. Du styr sedan paketerings- och utleveransflödet i produktionshallen- oavsett om det gäller mindre sändningar eller större volymer. Du ansvarar även för god ordning och pallstruktur på produktionsytan.
Arbetsuppgifter
Linjearbete & Packning: Betjäna vår automatiska etiketteringslinje (påmatning till transportband och avplockning från akkumuleringsbord), packa färdiga varor och färdigställa utleveranser.
Batch- & Packplanering: Analysera inkommande ordrar och lagersaldon för färdiga produkter. Schemalägga tillverkningsbatcher åt blandnings- och fyllningsteamet samt lägga upp det dagliga packschemat.
Färdigvaror & Pallstruktur: Utföra regelbundna lagerräkningar av färdiga produkter samt ansvara för struktur och ordning på pallytorna i produktionshallen.
Tätt Teamsamarbete: Arbeta i nära kontakt med tillverkningsteamet för att synka schemat mot leveransdeadlines.
Spårbarhet & Utrustning: Kontrollera batchnummer och utgångsdatum före utleverans samt logga data via Excel och tavlor. Hantera manuella/elektriska pallyftare och tejpmaskiner.

Arbetstider & Kvalifikationer
Heltid (40 h/vecka), dagtid. Tillsvidareanställning (provanställning tillämpas). Arbetet är fysiskt.
Noggrann, strukturerad och lärovillig med stark känsla för precision och ordning.
Goda/flytande kunskaper i antingen svenska eller engelska är ett krav.
Meriterande: Erfarenhet av packning, orderhantering, tillverkning eller truckkort (A+B).

Om Swedish Nutra
Swedish Nutra är ett Malmöbaserat familjeföretag som tillverkar flytande kosttillskott för en global marknad. Hos oss möter du ett ungt, drivet och mångkulturellt team där engelska är en helt naturlig del av vardagen. Production Specialist – Packaging & Dispatch
About the Job
Looking for a dynamic, hands-on role that pairs packaging line operations with production scheduling and inventory flow? At Swedish Nutra in Mellersta Hamnen, Malmö, we are seeking a detail-oriented team member to take charge of labeling, packing, and dispatching orders on time.
In this role, you will evaluate incoming orders and inventory levels to schedule required batch production runs for our manufacturing team. You will also organize the daily packaging queue and dispatch workflow, handling volume demands ranging from smaller shipments to large multi-pallet orders — while keeping our staging areas organized. Full on-site training is provided!

Packaging Line Operations: Operate our automated labeling line, pack finished goods, and stage outbound orders.
Batch & Production Scheduling: Review incoming orders and finished stock to schedule batch runs for the mixing team and set daily packaging priorities to hit shipping deadlines.
Inventory & Staging: Conduct routine stock counts of finished goods and keep pallet staging zones clean, safe, and structured.
Daily Coordination: Work closely throughout the day with mixing and bottling teams to align production output with dispatch deadlines.
Quality & Compliance: Verify lot numbers, expiry dates, and batch records using Excel and tracking boards. Operate manual/electric pallet jacks and taping machinery.

Terms: Full-time (40 hrs/week, day shifts). Permanent position (probationary period applies). Physically active role.
Profile: Detail-oriented, organized, and eager to take on expanding operational responsibility over time.
Languages: Good command of either English or Swedish is required (fluent in at least one).
"Good to have" experience: Background in packaging lines, order fulfillment, manufacturing, or holding a forklift license (A+B).

Swedish Nutra is a Malmö-based family business producing premium liquid supplements distributed worldwide. You’ll be joining a young, energetic, and multicultural team where English is spoken daily. We offer a warm, collaborative workplace culture where every team member is valued and given room to grow.

jobs.occupation: Senior R&D Engineer & Programme Lead  Industrial Decarbonisation
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. 
Job Description
Do you want to help shape Vattenfall’s role in the decarbonisation of industry? 
We are looking for a Senior R&D Engineer & Programme Lead – Industrial Decarbonisation to shape and lead the Industry Decarbonisation programme within Vattenfall R&D’s Energy Transition portfolio. 
The programme brings together around 8 colleagues, combining strategic direction with hands-on involvement in shaping and progressing R&D initiatives. 
You will work at the intersection of technology, business and industrial transformation. Together with the Portfolio Manager and other relevant stakeholders, you will shape the programme’s direction, identify new opportunities and lead a team of engineers, analysts and project managers in turning complex ideas into well-defined initiatives and decision-ready proposals. 
During your first year, your focus will be on establishing clear programme priorities, strengthening collaboration across the project teams and ensuring that selected projects deliver concrete outputs and results, beyond project plans and proposals. 
 
Your primary responsibilities will include: 
Lead and develop the Industry Decarbonisation programme in line with Vattenfall’s strategy, providing strategic input and identifying new opportunities within industrial electrification and decarbonisation. 
Translate business needs into well-defined projects and partnerships, and clear recommendations to support decisions. 
Build trusted relationships across Vattenfall and initiate collaborations with industrial companies, technology providers, academia and research institutes. 
Define and maintain the programme’s scope, objectives and roadmap, and ensure effective governance, prioritisation, risk management, resource planning and reporting. 
Lead and coordinate the technical work and project team members across the programme, providing clear priorities and technical direction. The role does not include line management responsibility. 

Qualifications

You are an experienced technical project or programme leader who can connect technology development with business needs and turn complex opportunities into tangible progress. 
We believe that you have: 
A relevant academic degree in engineering, energy systems, industrial economics, business or a related field. 
Extensive experience in the energy sector, process industry, industrial transformation or another technology-intensive environment. 
Experience leading projects, programmes, R&D initiatives or innovation activities, translating objectives into structured delivery and measurable results. 
Sound commercial judgement and experience in connecting technology development with business value while building effective relationships with industrial and internal stakeholders. 
Experience in leading and coordinating multidisciplinary project teams and technical work, including providing technical guidance to colleagues with different levels of experience. 
Strong communication skills and the ability to prepare clear, well-founded recommendations for senior stakeholders. 
Fluency in Swedish and English. 

Experience in industrial decarbonisation, electrification, hydrogen, carbon capture, industrial heat, energy systems analysis or related value chains is highly desirable. 
A good understanding of Vattenfall’s organisation and governance, or experience of navigating a comparable matrix-based energy or industrial organisation, is considered an advantage. 
You as a person 
You are proactive, curious and comfortable taking initiative. You combine strategic thinking with structured execution, maintain momentum when conditions change and build trust across organisational boundaries. You bring a quality mindset to results, documentation and ways of working. 
As a technical leader, you provide clear direction while encouraging ownership within the project teams. You foster collaboration, constructive technical dialogue and shared responsibility for results. You help create a positive and engaging working environment within the programme, where colleagues feel involved, share ideas openly and enjoy working together. 

Additional Information

Our Offer 
We offer a challenging and international work environment and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues as ‘Ask and Share’ concept is essential for the way we work. We offer attractive employment conditions (smart working, flexible working hours and a good-work-life balance) and opportunities for personal and professional development. Click here for further information. 
 
Location 
Solna 
We welcome your application in English, no later than 22 November 2026. We will not be able to handle applications sent in with other means than via our website. An assessment is a part of the recruitment process. 
For more information about the position, you are welcome to contact the hiring manager Nicklas Simonsson, Section Manager, Energy Systems & Processes, on +46 70 271 91 93. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact recruiter Carolina Bölander, Carolina.boelander@vattenfall.com. 
Trade Union representatives are Akademikerna – Shahriar Badiei, Ledarna – Christer Gustafsson, SEKO – Juha Siipilehto, Unionen – Anders Bohlin. You can reach them via 08-739 50 00. 
Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classed the final candidates might be subjected to a security vetting process, according to the Swedish legislation. 
 We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.occupation: Vessel Engineer to the Fleet Department
jobs.description:
Our Fleet Department is growing! We are looking for a Vessel Engineer to join our fleet department, who wants to be part of a close-knit team on board our survey vessels, delivering survey operations across Europe.
About us:
Njord Survey was founded in 2015 with a clear ambition: to challenge how offshore surveys are delivered. By combining state-of-the-art technology with innovative thinking, we deliver high-quality hydrographic and geophysical surveys more efficiently, for navigation, dredging, charting, marine construction for renewable energy and more.
We are in an exciting phase of growth, now with more than 120 dedicated employees delivering tailored solutions to meet each project’s and client’s needs.
Scope of work:
At Njord Survey we have a set-up where the processing of data is carried out from the Gothenburg office while the vessel crew is responsible for collecting the data. Our lean crewed vessels typically have a crew of between 2 to 8 people depending on the vessel size and project. For this position, offshore work will be conducted onboard vessel owned by Njord Survey. Our vessels operate in Europe, where work is conducted for two weeks at a time, followed by four weeks off.
On board, we work as one team. The vessel operates independently in planning and executing survey operations, in close collaboration with the office and our onshore processing team. Together, the crew is responsible for the safe navigation, operation and maintenance of the vessel, including onboard planning, procurement, inventory and reporting to project management. We are constantly developing how we operate, and your experience and ideas are part of that.
As Engineer you are responsible for the technical condition of the vessel. Our vessels have a high degree of automation and electronics, so the work spans machinery, electrical systems, and control and automation. You work independently in your area, but you are never alone: you have the support of the crew on board and of colleagues ashore, including the Technical Superintendent.
Your work will mainly be situated on our larger vessels, Northern Storm and Northern Gale. It also includes supporting our smaller vessels, which do not have an engineer on board.
The position includes travels in Europe and a chance to experience new places. We are proud to be using the latest technology to deliver high quality products to our clients. We collaborate with world leading tech companies such as Kongsberg, Volvo Penta, Humphree, Comap and Seakeeper to continuously optimize our vessels.
Requirements
STCW engine certificate

Basic safety STCW

B driving licence

Medical certificate, ENG1 or equivalent

Practical experience as an engineer on board vessels, including working independently

Documented experience of troubleshooting and repairing machinery, electrical systems and automation/electronics on board

EU/EEA citizenship and residency in Sweden

Professional proficiency in English, spoken and written

Merits (not required)
Experience from the offshore survey industry

Experience from diverse vessels with different technical set-ups

Experience of systems from Kongsberg, Volvo Penta, Humphree, Comap or Seakeeper

Knowledge of the equipment of our vessels Northern Storm and Northern Gale

Completed the program of Engine officer class VII (Maskinbefäl klass VII) and/or Marine Engineer (Sjöingenjörsexamen)

Professional proficiency in Swedish

Location: Offshore
Working time: 2 weeks of work followed by 4 weeks off from work
Our offers to you:
We offer a workplace for you to grow and to stay. At Njord Survey you become part of an experienced team who have fun together and build on each other’s ideas. We invest in our personnel and believe that competence development should be a combination of gained experience from diverse projects together with courses, workshops and activities.
We offer a wide range of employee benefits such as a wellness benefit of 5000 SEK/year, private medical insurance, access to our personnel benefit’s portal, team activities and more.
Our recruitment process:
The recruitment process consists of several evaluation steps to ensure a qualitative process. First a phone interview for us to learn more about your ambitions and for you to get to know Njord Survey and our offers better, followed by online tests and a competence-based interview with the department manager. The aim of the process is for you to learn about the content of the role and for us to evaluate if you have the right profile for the position. You can read more about our recruitment process at the career page here.
Feel free to hand in your application in Swedish or English.
The application will be open until the 22nd of November 2026
Candidate selection is ongoing, please hand in your application as soon as possible.
We are looking forward reading your application!
We kindly ask to not be contacted for external recruitment services.
The company is covered by the collective agreement Utveckling & Tjänster. A local trade union representing Sveriges Ingenjörer/Saco can be contacted at saco@njordsurvey.se.

Our vision
To be recognized as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community, through internationally recognized learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.
Description/Purpose 
The Head of Learning, together with other members of the school leadership team, strategically develops the school and ensures that SIS maintains its  Mission, Vision, values, policies, and procedures. 
The Head of Learning has a key role to play in ensuring the development of the SIS curriculum that is focused on the SIS Mission and Vision to ensure the highest quality for students’ learning, internationalism, and innovation to meet future challenges. The Head of Learning is in charge of the school’s (re)accreditation processes.

Promotes the school’s definition of learning and internationalism and keeps them alive throughout the school. 
Is in charge of the school’s vertical and horizontal alignment of curriculum as well as its regular revisions. 
Creates the agenda and leads the Educational Leadership Team meetings.

Works with the Advancement Director to identify and develop Cases for Support.
Assists with the strategic development of the whole school in cooperation with other members of the leadership team to meet future challenges the school may face. 
Gives appropriate feedback to the Board when called upon to do so.

Required Qualifications and Attributes
Has previous experience in a leadership position within a school.
Has previous successful experience with IB Programmes. 
Holds a university degree, either a BA in Education or Teaching qualifications.
Demonstrates strong team leadership and excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Is community-oriented and motivated to involve the full range of the school community - staff, students, and parents in the management and development of the curriculum.
Acts as a school ambassador in engaging with external stakeholders when needed.
Is sensitive towards, and familiar with, a diverse range of student learning needs.
Is sensitive toward and understands cross-cultural issues. 
Is successful in sharing teaching best practices and inspires a love of learning.
Is fluent in English (reading, writing, speaking).
Demonstrates ability to effectively manage human, financial, and physical resources to deliver a high-quality organizational outcome.
Has the ability to collaborate and work effectively in a team.
Has the ability to show initiative and work independently. 
Has the ability to function effectively under pressure. 
Has a pleasant and friendly personality.
Is a self-reflective life-long learner.
Has strong ethical principles and a sense of fairness.

Preferred Education and Experience
Demonstrated interest in remaining at the forefront of educational trends. 
Demonstrated strategic thinking and analytical skills and the ability to use those to influence the educational agenda of the school.
Proven track record of success in leading members of a school’s faculty.

As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation. 

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check from the last year of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

Administrative Position
Permanent full-time (with six months probationary period)
Starting: August 6, 2027, or such other date as may be mutually agreed upon by both parties.

Salary
Individually negotiated
Application

Are you interested in shaping your career in Finance within a global company? Join Arla Foods as a Finance Graduate in Denmark, Sweden, or Germany, where you will develop your skills, gain international experience, and drive business impact. As part of a dynamic Finance organisation, you'll contribute to sustainability efforts and help shape the future of Finance using cutting-edge digital technologies and data.
 
About our Finance Graduate Programme
The Finance Graduate Programme is a 2-year programme consisting of three rotations across our global Finance organisation. You'll enhance your core finance skills and develop essential competencies in Business & Performance, Data & Digital, and Strategy & Execution. Throughout the programme, you will be exposed to key finance disciplines while developing your strategic, personal, and professional skills to ensure you have the capabilities needed to succeed in the future of Finance.
We are looking for graduates to join in Denmark, Sweden, and Germany, and as part of the programme, you will have a 6-month rotation abroad in one of our European offices. Your Finance Graduate journey begins on 1st September 2027, where you will be hired on a permanent employment contract from day one and will continue your career within Finance in Arla Foods after finishing the 2-year graduate programme.
 
How will you make an impact as a Finance Graduate?
As a Finance Graduate, you will be a part of a highly competent Finance organisation contributing to both daily operations and cross-functional projects to drive the business forward. You will get your own areas of responsibility, enabling on-the-job learning, and you will get to explore the following areas within Finance
Business & Performance (12 months – home country) You will apply analytical skills to provide guidance for decision-makers and develop a strong understanding of financial performance through analysis and modeling, while enhancing your ability to influence others
Data & Digital (6 months – home country or abroad) You will leverage data to generate insights, grow advanced analytics and visualization skills, and apply digital technology to automate and optimize tasks for efficiency
Strategy & Execution (6 months – home country or abroad) You will build and communicate business cases for investments, engage in problem solving and stakeholder management, and use finance to drive business growth and create value

 
What will make you a successful Finance Graduate?
To apply for the Finance Graduate Programme, please ensure that you can tick off the following boxes
Hold a bachelor's or master's degree from a university by September 2027 or have graduated within the last 2 years. We are open to various educational backgrounds, so what truly matters is your interest in Finance and curious mindset
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience from work and/or extracurricular activities
Being professionally fluent in English
Currently residing in, or willing to relocate to, either Denmark, Sweden or Germany, and being internationally mobile for at least 6 months as part of the programme 

 
In addition, we are looking for graduates who
Lead with confidence, make independent decisions, are results-oriented while valuing the journey to achieve those outcomes
Build positive relationships with a collaborative mindset and are open to feedback
Communicate complex information clearly and effectively
Demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to learn and explore
Use an analytical and structured approach to problem-solving with a proactive attitude

 
Why join Arla’s Finance Graduate Programme?
As part of our Finance Graduate Programme, you will receive a variety of development opportunities every step of the way. To ensure your professional and personal development, you will benefit from
Responsibilities from day one enabling on-the-job learning in three different areas
Graduate development camps, taking place in different markets with your graduate colleagues
One-to-one mentoring and sparring from senior leaders
Supportive graduate community across our graduate programmes 

 
Important information before application
The application period for the Finance Graduate Programme runs from November 2nd 2026 to January 3rd 2027. Before applying, please make sure that you have already prepared your CV and cover letter in English. You will be asked different questions on the application page, thus we recommend that you start the application process from a computer instead of a mobile phone or tablet.
 
For additional information, read more about the Finance Graduate Programme on our website. Here, you can get inspiration from some of our previous and current graduates and learn more about the programme. You can also read more about what to expect from the recruitment process.
 
Shape the Future of Dairy 
Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.description:
Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As Supplier Strategy Lead, you will help H&M Beauty Fragrance build the supplier partnerships and production capabilities needed to grow its fragrance business. You will shape and implement a strategy covering fragrance oils, suppliers that fill the finished products, packaging and components. Your focus will be on making product development and production faster and more efficient, while ensuring suppliers can support growing volumes.
This is a full-time temporary project employment of 12 months based in Stockholm. 
In this role, you will: 
Develop and coordinate a supplier plan for the fragrance business, covering fragrance oils, product filling, packaging and components. 
Assess supplier capabilities, capacity, cost structures, innovation potential and geographic footprint. 
Build long-term supplier partnerships and develop a supplier capability roadmap to support the growth of the fragrance business. 
Identify gaps in supplier capabilities, production bottlenecks and supply risks that could limit growth, increase costs or disrupt deliveries. 
Coordinate strategic production and capacity planning for key fragrance launches and programmes. 
Develop ways of working that bring supplier expertise into product development at an earlier stage. 
Simplify development and production processes to improve efficiency and speed-to-market. 
Compare existing approaches and introduce scalable solutions across formulation, packaging, packaging design and labelling, samples, testing and production. 
Organize sessions with suppliers to explore new ideas, review their capabilities and follow up on business priorities, together with the team responsible for day-to-day supplier coordination and other relevant colleagues. 
Turn strategy into practical solutions and follow through on implementation. 

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH 
You will join H&M Beauty at an exciting stage as we continue to build and scale our fragrance business. You will work cross-functionally with product manager, junior buyers, planner, designer, controller, logistics and external suppliers. 
You will work closely with merchandising colleagues in the production organisation and the fragrance product development team to align fragrance supplier capabilities and production capacity with assortment priorities. Together, you will translate plans for future fragrance products into clear supplier requirements and production plans. While the production office team manages daily activities, your focus will be on longer-term supplier development and improvements to how teams and suppliers work together. 

WHO YOU ARE 
We are looking for people with… 
Relevant experience in supplier management, supplier development, strategic sourcing, production planning, supply chain or product development. 
Experience in assessing, developing and managing supplier partnerships. 
Understanding of manufacturing processes, preferably within fragrance, beauty, cosmetics, consumer goods or another fast-moving product environment. 
Experience leading cross-functional projects and implementing process improvements. 
The ability to turn analysis and strategic plans into practical changes, then follow through on implementation. 
Strong analytical skills and the ability to bring together colleagues and suppliers with different priorities. 
A commercial mindset and the ability to balance product, supplier, operational and business needs. 
Fluency in English. 

And people who are… 
Collaborative, relationship-driven and comfortable working across functions and organisations. 
Curious, solution-focused and motivated by solving complex problems. 
Comfortable challenging existing ways of working and driving change. 
Resilient and adaptable in an environment where the way forward is not always clearly defined. 
Structured and able to create clarity in a developing area. 
Proactive, persistent and able to follow through. 
Motivated by helping the fragrance business launch products faster and support growing volumes by simplifying how products are developed and produced. 

WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. 
An example of our benefits: 
25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET). 
H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Learn more about the program here. 
With a presence in markets around the world, we offer extensive career development and international mobility. 

JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. 
This is a full-time temporary project employment of 12 months based in Stockholm. Please send your CV in English as soon as possible as profiles will be reviewed continuously.  
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.
